title: Plastic Production
description: This mod adds the plastic production
body:
this mod adds the plastic production. This mod is in development.

-New blocks (extruder, steam cracker, plastic creator, hyper furnace etc)

-New items (plastic strings, plastic sword, molds etc)

-New villager trade (you can buy virgin naphta by the weaponsmith)

I'll add new things in next updates

NeoForge 1.21.8

I hope you can enjoy and have fun with this mod!  The mechanism isn't that hard.
